icorp26

The goal of icorp26 is to support Lehman students and others in using the CDC RSS data this summer.

Installation

You can install the development version of icorp26 from GitHub with:

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("elinw/icorp26")

Data sets

For students, right now the package contains the data sets rss1 through rss7. You should be able to access any of this simply by loading the library

library(icorp26)

Learn more about rounds 1 to 5

You can learn about Round 6

You can learn about Round 7

For your project you should pick one of the rounds, unless you have a specific reason. Look at the topics and find the ones that most interest you.

You should also read about the purpose of the RSS system (who decides what the topics are) and about the methodology of the survey.

Once you have installed the package you can get some markdown files to get you started.

getstarted()
